# Native draw.io previews

Uses a focused extraction of document-svg 2.0.2 by ryusui-hiro:
https://github.com/ryusui-hiro/document-svg

Licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. Original license texts follow in --diagram-licenses.
Original source and revision, and local modifications, are recorded in
vendor/document-svg-drawio/UPSTREAM.md. External stencil libraries and network
resources are not loaded. No diagrams.net application or browser engine is used.
